newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stock market closed for twin festivals.
newsitem.headline: KL stock market closed for twin festivals.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur stock market is closed from February 6 through February 11 for the Chinese New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr festivals.
On Wednesday, the Composite Index of 100 large capitalised shares closed up 6.59 points or 0.53 percent to 1,241.95. The small-cap Second Board index ended up 9.64 points or 1.59 percent to 616.92.
Dealers say stock prices could resume next Wednesday on a firm note as participants return from holidays.
